geometry.panel_groups: panel1:left exact le cinabon menu; panel1:right compact monochrome status and calendar. panel2:center grouped-window-list only; no center clock island.
geometry.geometry_note: All sizes are Cinnamon logical pixels. 22px top panel and titlebar, 22px controls, 16px status icons; 84px transparent bottom actor with 64px dock icon canvases at 66px center pitch and a 52px perspective shelf at its base; icon baseline 20px above screen bottom; mirror visible 18px below baseline. Traffic lights use 4px top inset. Verify actual rendered native-scale geometry; inherited GTK/CSD padding must not inflate the titlebar.
geometry.composition: A slim continuous gray menu/status bar frames the archived purple aurora. White file panes sit beside pale blue-gray sidebars under unified gray titlebar/toolbars, with no texture or pinstripes. Centered regular-weight titles accompany three tiny bright circular controls at the left. The dock is a centered trapezoidal glass shelf under colorful free-standing icons, with a narrow front lip, actual vertically mirrored icon reflections and small luminous blue-white round running indicators; a segmented perspective separator precedes the document/trash endcap. Its surrounding full-width actor is transparent. Popovers and dialogs remain light and compact.

typography.verification: Lucida Grande confirmed by fc-list/fc-match on 2026-09-30 using preset-scoped FONTCONFIG_FILE=presets/gnu-darwin-aqua/fontconfig.conf; resolves staged desktop/fonts/Lucida Grande.ttf without a live font installation. Genuine Apple font extracted by coordinator from the official 2007 Safari 3 package; family authentic, binary identity with Mac OS X 10.6 unproven. Liberation Mono remains installed and confirmed. Private rendering and future application must use the preset font configuration.

materials.status: Design target; acceptance requires fresh runtime evidence, not static CSS presence.
materials.icon_source: Clone or render the same icon artwork actually displayed by each launcher/window group; preserve original artwork alpha and update both main icon and reflection together.

reflection.transform: vertical flip of full-size 64px icon at native width; no vertical compression
reflection.opacity_confidence: Visual estimate from composited screenshot, not an extracted original opacity value.
reflection.fade: linear alpha ramp from 0.30 at the icon baseline to 0 at 18px; preserve source alpha; the front lip may occlude the final pixel
reflection.clip: Below icon baseline and inside the glass-plane polygon; never paint a second click target.

running_indicator.placement: Center beneath each running application icon; draw above its reflection; absent for nonrunning favorites and nonapplication endcaps.
running_indicator.count_rule: One light per running application group, not one per window.

separator.band_note: Half-open logical-pixel intervals translated from visible source bands; widening toward viewer.
separator.fill: Pale neutral highlight at approximately 0.28 alpha; tune against reference composite; do not use an upright dark divider.
separator.placement: Between application groups and the document/trash endcap; no duplicate separator when endcap is empty.

magnification.optional_curve: If implemented, smooth raised cosine versus horizontal pointer distance over two icon pitches, scale returns to1 beyond influence radius.
magnification.evidence: The reference screenshot is idle; it does not establish the source magnification preference, maximum size, timing or distance curve. Optional magnification must have independent interaction evidence and must update icon/reflection together.

layout_scaling.factor: s = configured icon canvas / 64; scale all dock metrics together, then round consistently to device pixels.
layout_scaling.ideal_outer_width: 2*32*s + icon_count*64*s + max(0,icon_count-1)*2*s + (32*s when endcap separator exists)
layout_scaling.overflow: If the complete favorite/running/endcap row exceeds monitor width, apply one uniform scale to icon and shelf geometry; preserve order and center alignment, never remove favorites.

glass_plane.stop_axis: 0 at rear edge,1 at front edge
glass_plane.opacity_confidence: Estimated white-overlay fit from nearby outside/inside screenshot pixels; typical fitted alpha0.39-0.46; original compositing unknown. Tune against full reference at matching wallpaper coordinates.
glass_plane.rear_edge: fine diffuse highlight; avoid heavy opaque outline
glass_plane.clip: All plane layers stay inside the perspective polygon; width follows the icon row.
